title: Modality Readiness Under Stalled ICE
objective: Demonstrate that successful signaling, ICE readiness, inbound media, rendered video, and RTT readiness are preserved as separate observations when candidate gathering is delayed or incomplete.

historicalBasis.observation: ACE Direct carried a JsSIP 3.5.1 patch that bounded ICE candidate gathering with a two-second escape path.
historicalBasis.scope: Motivating interoperability evidence only; it does not establish that the same failure exists in current JsSIP, browsers, Elixip, OpenMeetings, or Baudot.

requiredBeforeRunnable: deterministic ICE manipulation or controllable interoperability peer
modality readiness observations emitted into Omni evidence
at least one normal control and one stalled-ICE arm

baudotBoundary.intent: Keep the observation vocabulary portable so Baudot can adopt the same readiness contract for SIP RTT/T.140 conformance work.
baudotBoundary.claim: This planned trial does not claim RFC 4103, T.140, or Baudot conformance.
